note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: Xi pitches China as AI partner to developing world, warns against security overreach
items.blurb: At WAIC's opening, Xi offered the Global South AI training and cooperation while cautioning against risks and Western security controls.

items.title: China's Moonshot AI unveils Kimi K3 model it says rivals OpenAI, Anthropic
items.blurb: China's largest model yet (2.8T params) beats Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 on some benches; open weights due Jul 27.

items.title: China just erased America's AI lead
items.blurb: Kimi K3's frontier-level, soon-open results reignite debate over how durable the U.S. lead in AI really is.

items.title: AI godfathers converge on regulation as Washington intervenes
items.blurb: OpenAI, Anthropic and Google DeepMind CEOs publish strikingly similar AI-rules proposals as the US twice restricts frontier-model access.

items.title: Nvidia unveils new AI model and expands Japan's physical-AI ecosystem
items.blurb: Cosmos 3 Edge lets systems perceive and navigate physical environments in real time, deepening Nvidia's robotics push in Japan.

items.title: China's open-weight Kimi K3 stuns AI world with frontier-level results
items.blurb: Moonshot's 2.8T open Mixture-of-Experts model posts near-frontier benchmarks, narrowing the gap between China's open labs and US leaders.

items.title: Nvidia-backed Fireworks hits $17.5 billion valuation as firms pursue cheaper AI models
items.blurb: Inference host crosses $1B annualized revenue as rising token costs push enterprises toward open-weight alternatives.

items.title: ASML raises full-year guidance a second time on strong AI chip demand
items.blurb: Dutch litho maker lifts 2026 sales to EUR43-45B on 'extremely strong' first-half orders, signaling the AI capex buildout keeps compounding.

items.title: Meet GPT-Red: an LLM super-hacker OpenAI built to make its models safer
items.blurb: OpenAI reveals GPT-Red, an internal offensive-security model used to find and patch weaknesses in its other models.

items.title: Mira Murati's Thinking Machines releases its first model, Inkling
items.blurb: Thinking Machines Lab debuts Inkling, an open-weight 975B multimodal MoE, betting enterprises want customizable models over renting closed frontier systems.

items.title: Anthropic moves closer to mega-IPO as bankers line up investor meetings
items.blurb: Underwriters begin sounding out investor demand ahead of a possible October listing at Anthropic's ~$965B valuation.

items.title: Fed's Warsh says AI spending may lift prices without lasting inflation
items.blurb: In Senate testimony, Warsh argues AI capital spending could raise prices short-term but not fuel durable inflation.

items.title: Anthropic ramps up hiring for teams meant to head off AI catastrophe
items.blurb: Anthropic is staffing dozens of roles to block AI-assisted chemical, nuclear, cyber and bio misuse as capabilities climb.

items.title: Trump blasts New York's AI data-center moratorium, says state should reverse it 'immediately'
items.blurb: New York became the first state to pause new hyperscale data centers; Trump pressed the governor to lift the one-year ban.

items.title: Tim Scott wants to hear from Warsh on data centers and AI
items.blurb: Senate Banking chair signals AI power demand and its inflation risk are now central to Fed oversight questions.

items.title: Litigation could pause OpenAI's device plan
items.blurb: Apple's trade-secret suit threatens to stall OpenAI's consumer-hardware ambitions, injecting fresh legal risk into its Jony Ive device push.

items.title: Employees sue Meta, alleging AI was used to conduct layoffs discriminatorily
items.blurb: Current and former Meta workers allege the company relied on AI to select layoffs in a way that discriminated against them.

items.title: Cybersecurity stocks rally on AI-spending comments and Mythos rollout
items.blurb: Security stocks jumped after IBM's Krishna and Anthropic's restricted Mythos deployment reshaped how AI shifts enterprise security spend.

items.title: Wall Street warms to Apple's AI strategy
items.blurb: Investors reassess Apple's slower, partnership-led AI approach as its suit against OpenAI escalates.

items.title: New York becomes first U.S. state to pause new AI data centers
items.blurb: Gov. Hochul's executive order pauses environmental permits for data-center projects of 50 MW or more for up to a year.

items.title: IBM stock plunges as much as 26% as CEO says AI chip spending took a toll
items.blurb: Worst intraday drop since at least 1968; shifting AI-economy priorities are squeezing IBM's core business even as chip suppliers boom.

items.title: Gov. Hochul signs data center moratorium executive order
items.blurb: First statewide pause on large data centers, with community-benefit and environmental-impact rules to follow within 60 days.

items.title: Google DeepMind's Demis Hassabis calls for a U.S.-led global AI watchdog
items.blurb: Hassabis proposes an industry-funded, technically-staffed global body to evaluate frontier models before year-end.

items.title: DeepMind's Hassabis calls for a U.S.-led AI standards body
items.blurb: Hassabis proposes a FINRA-style body to vet frontier models pre-release, ideally operational before year-end; labs would share models voluntarily first.
